title: Open the compact Kubernetes log
detail: Real CRI records with a nested JSON payload.

title: Press w — make JSON readable
detail: Expand the nested payload directly inside the log view.

title: Move through the expanded events
detail: Keep the original timestamp and structured fields in view.

title: Press 6 — inspect the detected fields
detail: Structured field selection is available without rewriting the log.

title: Type service:payment
detail: Add an include filter; keep only payment events.

title: Type level:error
detail: Stack a second include filter on top of service:payment.

title: Type x — remove last filter
detail: Undo level:error; keep the broader service:payment filter.

title: Press w — switch back to compact
detail: The filters stay active while the JSON view changes.

title: Press w — expand the payload again
detail: From compact records to readable JSON in one keystroke.
